title: Use Higgsfield Marketing Studio (Seedance 2.0) to generate finished ads by…
content:
Use Higgsfield Marketing Studio (Seedance 2.0) to generate finished ads by pasting a product image or a product link and running the end-to-end workflow.

Create an avatar for the ad by uploading a photo of yourself (or building an avatar inside the tool) before generating.

Generate variations by selecting from the 9 built-in ad styles (e.g., UGC, unboxing, reviews, tutorials, hyper motion) to produce multiple ad formats in a few clicks.
